notes.title: OSAKA EXPO 2025
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575737/bac4eb1ea5c5c314fda413cc0fc7eb83cb635005.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re incredibly proud to be part of the Argentine video game delegation at [b]Expo Osaka 2025[/b], thanks to the [b]Games Around The World[/b] initiative![/p][p]This recognition gives us even more motivation to keep pushing forward with the development of [b]Beatlords[/b]—a project we pour our heart, soul, and passion into every single day.[/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who believes in our work and supports us on this journey. Onward and upward!

More info at [url="https://gamesaroundtheworld.com/video-games/beatlords/"]https://gamesaroundtheworld.com/video-games/beatlords/[/url][/p][p][/p]
